title: Keep getting persistent high alerts, despite the alert being switched off
body:
Have also tried disabling all alerts, but  it still fires even when sugars are below the high alert.
Any ideas?

comments.body: It is linked to the high mark on the chart but I wouldn't expect you to get it when persistent high alerting is switched off.

@alexmoir1 Would you please close this issue if it has already been addressed?
